```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[aInput,bInput,cInput,result,reset])
$a: number = 30
$b: number = 2
$c: number = 5
let distance = $a * $b + $c
aInput = Slider(label="速度", bind=$a, min=0, max=100, unit="km/h")
bInput = NumberField(label="时长", bind=$b, unit="h")
cInput = NumberField(label="已有路程", bind=$c, unit="km")
result = Metric(label="距离", value=distance, unit="km")
reset = Button(label="重置", action=Reset())
```

root = Column(children=[form,ask])

合成示例，仅用于离线评分测试。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,result,chart,table,ask,reset])
$a: number = 1
$b: number = 1
$useOffset: boolean = true
let offset = $useOffset ? $b : 0
let resultValue = $a * 5 + offset
let points = @sample(x => $a * x + offset, 0, 5, 6)
form = Form(children=[aInput,bInput,toggle])
aInput = Slider(label="斜率", bind=$a, min=-5, max=10)
bInput = NumberField(label="截距", bind=$b, visible=$useOffset)
toggle = Switch(label="启用截距", bind=$useOffset)
result = Metric(label="x=5", value=resultValue, unit="u")
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"])
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x"},{"key":"y","label":"y"}])
ask = Button(label="解释参数", form=form, action=Ask(text="解释这些参数。", context={"a":$a,"b":$b,"useOffset":$useOffset,"yAt5":resultValue}))
reset = Button(label="重置", action=Reset())
```
